newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Swedish April unemployment seen 8.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Swedish April unemployment seen 8.1 pct.

text.p: Sweden's unemployment rate is expected to fall to 8.1 percent in April from 8.4 percent in March, a Reuter poll of 12 analysts showed on Tuesday.
Forecasts ranged from 7.9 percent to 8.5 percent.
In April last year, unemployment amounted to 7.5 percent, according to Statistics Sweden.
For the full-year 1997 nine economists expected unemployment of 8.0 percent on average with forecasts ranging from 7.3 percent to 8.4 percent.
Sweden's Labour Market Board (Ams) released its unemployment data on May 7, saying unemployment was 7.5 percent in April this year, down from 8.0 percent in March.
Statistics Sweden will publish its official figure at 1100 GMT on May 15.
Analysts giving a monthly figure came from: Aragon, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Handelsbanken, HSBC Midland, IDEA, J P Morgan, PaineWebber, Penser, S-E-Banken, Swedbank and Unibank.
Analysts giving a full-year figure came from: Aragon, Den Danske Bank, Handelsbanken, IDEA, J P Morgan, Penser, PaineWebber, S-E-Banken, Swedbank and Transferator.
